The HECKTOR challenge returns for its 2026 edition at the 29th International Conference on Medical Image Computing and Computer-Assisted Intervention (MICCAI 2026) in Strasbourg, France. Building on the success of previous editions (2020–2025), HECKTOR continues to advance clinically relevant machine learning solutions for head and neck cancer.

RetinaQuant is a deep learning system designed for early, automated classification of retinal diseases using Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT) images.
